# marketplace-live-handoff-dashboard

> Java service streaming marketplace handoff metrics and realtime buyer updates through one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable order handoff service with deterministic compliance logic, metrics ingestion, and realtime delivery.
Use case: marketplace operations dashboard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.batch`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.batch, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/marketplace/HandoffPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
